def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    lr=[r for r,row in enumerate(g) if any(c not in (0,1) for c in row)]
    if not lr: return g
    r0=lr[0]
    cols=[c for c in range(W) if g[r0][c] not in (0,1)]
    nxt={}
    for i,c in enumerate(cols):
        nxt[c]=(cols[i+1] if i+1<len(cols) else W-1)-c
    for c in cols:
        h=nxt[c]
        for k in range(1,h+1):
            rr=r0-k
            if rr>=0: g[rr][c]= g[r0][c] if k==h else 1
    return g
